import asyncio

async def act(page):
    # Scroll to the bottom of the homepage
    await page.evaluate('window.scrollTo(0, document.body.scrollHeight)')
    await asyncio.sleep(2)  # Wait for any lazy-loaded content
    
    # Try to find and click the pagination link for page 6 using accessibility tree-centric selectors
    try:
        # First, try to find by role 'link' with name containing '6' (case-insensitive substring match)
        page6_link = page.get_by_role('link', name='6')
        await page6_link.click()
        await page.wait_for_load_state('load')
        return "Successfully navigated to page 6 of the blog feed."
    except Exception as e:
        # If not found by name, try to find by role 'link' with name containing 'Page 6' or similar
        try:
            page6_link = page.get_by_role('link', name='Page 6')
            await page6_link.click()
            await page.wait_for_load_state('load')
            return "Successfully navigated to page 6 of the blog feed via 'Page 6'."
        except Exception:
            # If still not found, check for any link with role 'link' that might be pagination
            # Use .all() to get all links and filter by text content
            all_links = await page.get_by_role('link').all()
            for link in all_links:
                text = await link.text_content()
                if text and '6' in text and ('page' in text.lower() or 'paged' in text.lower()):
                    await link.click()
                    await page.wait_for_load_state('load')
                    return f"Successfully navigated to page 6 of the blog feed via link with text: {text}."
            return "Could not find pagination link for page 6. Pagination might not be visible or use a different pattern."
